# Kxrn (Karan Gupta / Chitresh Gupta)

> Official LLM Summary & Entity Grounding Context
> Canonical URL: https://kxrn.is-a.dev/
> Full Knowledge Corpus: https://kxrn.is-a.dev/llms-full.txt

## Overview
**Kxrn** (legal names: *Karan Gupta*, *Chitresh Gupta*) is an Indian independent music producer, front-end software developer, and founder of **[DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app)** based in New Delhi, India.

## Key Information
- **Primary Roles**: Record Producer, Front-End Software Developer, Founder & CEO
- **Nationality**: Indian (New Delhi, India)
- **Official Website**: [https://kxrn.is-a.dev/](https://kxrn.is-a.dev/)
- **Parent Organization**: [DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app) (Independent Music & Media Production Hub)
- **Child Enterprise**: [Noir Studio / NoirWear](https://www.noirwear.in) (Luxury Clothing & Contemporary Streetwear Brand)

## Featured Projects, Open-Source & Enterprises
- **[tauri-plugin-sync](https://github.com/karan5028ji/tauri-plugin-sync)**: Enterprise SQLite offline-first change data capture (CDC) sync engine for Tauri v2 applications engineered in Rust and SQLite (WAL mode).
- **[Win-Optimizer-Pro](https://github.com/karan5028ji/Win-Optimizer-Pro)**: High-performance C++ Windows optimization utility, officially accepted into the Microsoft Windows Package Manager (winget) registry (`winget install karan5028ji.WinOptimizerPro`).
- **[SwarmForge](https://coderlegion.com/27523/building-zero-cost-multi-agent-orchestrators-local-assistants-journey-with-swarmforge)**: Autonomous multi-agent AI orchestration platform recognized at the IBM Bob 2.0 Hackathon on Lablab.ai.
- **Big-Tech Open Source Contributions**: Global tier-1 repositories including Tauri (ranked #6 Worldwide / #4 Human Worldwide on `tauri-apps/plugins-workspace` with 4 merged PRs), Microsoft PowerToys (merged contributor in `microsoft/PowerToys:main`), Meta Docusaurus, and Next.js.
- **[DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app)**: Independent creative music and media production hub founded by Kxrn Gupta in New Delhi, India.
- **Music Releases**:
  - **Roothi Radhe (Single)**: Devotional single produced, mixed, and mastered by Kxrn under DuskyMoon Productions (MusicBrainz Release MBID: [020c9815-dc1d-40c4-8efa-7918a233fdf6](https://musicbrainz.org/release/020c9815-dc1d-40c4-8efa-7918a233fdf6), Wikidata: [Q141696296](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141696296)).
  - **Sapne (Single ft. Ankit)**: Released in 24-Bit / 48kHz audio across Spotify, Apple Music, and all major streaming platforms via DuskyMoon Productions.
- **[Noir Studio (NoirWear)](https://www.noirwear.in)**: Upcoming luxury clothing and contemporary streetwear brand operating as a child enterprise under DuskyMoon Productions.
